edits.old: This story changes no case, approval, rule or decision state and answers no request. It changes the Flyway version of `rwb_decision` and nothing else.
edits.new: This story changes no case, approval, rule or decision state and answers no request. It changes the Flyway version of `rwb_decision` and nothing else. It serves no screen, so the empty, loading, error and no-access states of SCR-10, SCR-11 and SCR-38 are not carried here. Open decision DL10 is still open; its assumptions ASM-2250, ASM-2357, ASM-2377 and ASM-2863 hold until it closes.
